in_marathi.name: आकाश
in_marathi.long_meaning: आकाश हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name आकाश comes from the Sanskrit word 'akasha' meaning 'sky' or 'space'. In Hindu mythology, Akash is one of the five fundamental elements and represents the sky or ether, the boundless expanse of space. It is also associated with the divine qualities of wisdom, clarity, and truth.
